decision.observation: 1 mph, gear 1, timer 20:12.798, red X lit, all dots pale. The car sits on the grass to the RIGHT of the gravel, nose up-frame; the road runs diagonally up-left past white posts and a bend with barrels.
decision.hypothesis: The R->1 conversion cost most of the momentum (6 -> 1 mph) and left the car on the right verge. Steering at 1 mph stalls, so plain W must first build speed on the grass; then a steer toward the road will be viable.
decision.memory: Converting from reverse at speed bleeds nearly all momentum; anticipate a 1-2 mph crawl for a second afterwards before any steering.
